headline: Sourcegraph: 3 prices, 3 limits, 1 plan name changed (removed “Cody can retrieve codebase context to persona…”; added “1 User”)
added: • Unlimited autocomplete and increased chat message limits
Free is best for individuals working on hobby projects.
Cody can retrieve codebase context to personalize responses in a number of ways. For Free and Pro users, context is retrieved from their local repositories.

Users can upgrade or downgrade between Free and Pro within their account settings at any time. For Pro users upgrading to Enterprise Starter is also possible, but doing so currently does not cancel your subscription and you must cancel it yourself.
For Free and Pro users, Sourcegraph will use your data to fine-tune the model you are accessing unless you disable this feature.
The Enterprise Starter plan is currently compatible with GitHub, with a limit of indexing up to 100 repositories for search and context.

The Enterprise Starter plan supports up to 50 developers, and alongside a limit of 100 repositories for search and context, also includes 5Gb of storage. Adding additional seats gives you 1GB of additional storage per seat, for a maximum total of 10GB.
removed: Cody Free is best for individuals working on hobby projects or professional devs trying out AI coding assistants. Usage limits apply.
Cody Pro is best for professional developers who want unlimited usage and context for larger local codebases.

Cody can retrieve codebase context to personalize responses in a number of ways. One way is with embeddings, which are generated for local user repositories. Cody Free users can create embeddings for up to 200MB of code and Cody Pro users can create embeddings for up to 1GB of code.
Users can upgrade or downgrade between Cody Free and Cody Pro within their account settings at any time. To upgrade to Cody Enterprise, please contact our Sales team.
For Enterprise customers, Sourcegraph will not train on your company’s data. For Free and Pro tier users, Sourcegraph will not train on your data without your permission.
